newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ducatus has 5.94 pct Pakhoed stake.
newsitem.headline: Ducatus has 5.94 pct Pakhoed stake.

text.p: Dutch investment fund Ducatus NV said on Thursday it had taken a 5.94 percent stake in Dutch tank storage and shipping company Pakhoed.
Ducatus said it had taken the stake in the form of cumulative preference shares, with a total value of 35 million guilders.
A preference dividend of 5.96 percent of the effective value will be paid on this stake for a period of eight years and will be free of taxation, Ducatus said.
"This investment raises the average effective return of Ducatus' portfolio to 5.78 percent from 5.46 percent," Ducatus said.
"Adding Pakhoed to its portfolio, Ducatus further diversifies its investments," the fund said in a statement.
Including Pakhoed, the total value of investments of Ducatus now amounts to 324 million guilders, with shareholders' equity of 257 million guilders, Ducatus said.
Intrinsic value per share amounts to 130.06 guilders, while the total return since the beginning of 1996 has been 9.4 percent.
Ducatus is an investment fund of Van Lanschot Bankiers, and only invests in preference shares. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
